item.title: QField Is Cool
item.description: A small test page for validating pull request previews.
item.content:encoded:
QField is cool

This is a temporary test page for validating the GitHub Pages pull request preview workflow.

If this page is visible at /test/qfield-is-cool/, the preview deployment is publishing new content correctly.

What to check

  • The page renders with the normal QField website layout.
  • The URL works on the PR preview domain path.
  • Links and assets still load when the site is served from a preview subdirectory.
